
Skills carry only what needs judgment. `working-under-worklode` covers when a task is actually done, when to block versus push through, and when to release a worktree; it excludes renewal. Decomposition reuses the superpowers skills (`writing-plans`, `brainstorming`, `subagent-driven-development`) and re-emits results as `lode` tasks. The plugin files and the rest of the skill set are covered in WL-SPEC-81 §7 and §8.
